title: Open-closed triangle for arbitrary constant module coefficients
statement: Let Λ be any commutative ring in Type (u+1), let a:G→Y be an open immersion and i:Z→Y a closed immersion of schemes in universe u with range(i)=range(a)ᶜ. For every M in the ordinary unbounded derived category of ModuleCat Λ-valued sheaves on Y_et, the counit D(a_!)D(a^*)M→M and unit M→Ri_*D(i^*)M extend to a distinguished triangle. The functors and adjunctions are those of [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. No torsion, constructibility, Noetherian or quasi-compactness assumption is made.

proof.text: Apply the existing proved source theorem exists_distTriang_openClosed with A=ModuleCat Λ. This theorem is stated for Grothendieck abelian symmetric closed monoidal coefficients with functorial flat resolutions, which ModuleCat Λ satisfies for every commutative Λ. Its formal proof completes the open counit to a triangle, checks the restrictions of its third term, identifies that term with Ri_*i^*M by open-closed conservativity, and uses naturality of the closed unit to identify the second arrow. No new Lean proof is required: the cited source declaration is already proved.
